File of robert-adnas/posibil-penali at commit 581cd3a4c45b4b008dd86d531c02cfafa1d0909b. The JSON-LD of the project site names the repository (sameAs). The file is the base data of the archive: it holds records about named persons, so the inventory keeps the field names and observed types only, and no value. The final public records add fields that the build script and the validator declare (geography, county, verified_at, sources with label, kind, published_at, source_type, description); they are in the notes and not in this source. The site is a client-side application: the methodology page is a shell.
